gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G06 (map=24, 1900x764, land=762,763, 5 teams), all 8 [Nope] bots spawned in a tight eastern cluster (1492..1872, 136..368) with allyMinSep=112px, boxing 5 bots (lucas94, leo_tx, mark07, dave_w, ryan_m) into nb=0 by t=1800 and leaving only ethan21 (land front), kevin_k (coastal front), and noah88 (coastal front) exposed. Across G06, our squad launched 102 boats (63 [HL-INTERCEPT] chases + 39 idleBoats/boatOut/frogHop boats), burning 1,197,795 troops in 3.125%B boat tax and sending 2,884,798 troops to sea (total 4.08M direct troop drain, >6.1M with lost compound interest). Specifically: (1) seaSample(g, p, n, rnd) returns { c, o, d } (v27-team-live.js:1244), whereas tryClaimNearTeamIslands reads s.land / bestHit.land (v27-team-live.js:4699, 4771), causing tryClaimNearTeamIslands to return 0 boats in every game (isleKey='0_NaN', boatTo(pct, undefined) -> shoreNear(NaN) -> -1), while the unguarded V17.boatOut / boatFood / frogHopStep launched 39 boats (burning 231,753 tax + ~940,000 troops) from kevin_k (t=1890..3510, 11 boats) and noah88 (t=1980..2700, 7 boats), depressing kevin_k's density to d=6.7..19.5; (2) tryInterceptEnemyBoats had bTr>=80 (no fee<=alpha*bTr gate), causing 32/63 intercepts in G06 to pay a 3.125%B boat tax strictly larger than the enemy boat's entire troop count (e.g., t=3256 kevin_k and noah88 both chased a 140-troop boatId=230, paying 19,508 in boat tax = 139.3x the enemy boat!); (3) bQ.mt.mu(p, boatId) is only populated by AI bot interceptTick (bQ.iC.rq), NEVER by human/network g.chase (bB.qg.qy), so alreadyChasingTroops was permanently 0 and both kevin_k and noah88 double-chased 18 enemy boats (20 duplicate chase commands burning 648,372 troops); (4) urgentClose allowed single chases up to 35%B (pct<=360) with keepFloor=12*L, so at t=4103 noah88 (pct=345/1024, send=420,427, fee=38,996) and at t=4472 & t=4586 kevin_k (pct=344 & 356/1024, send=904,280, fee=82,898) drained 1.32M troops into the sea right as Team 4 counter-attacked on land, collapsing noah88 (t=4410), ryan_m (t=4611), lucas94 (t=4935), kevin_k's mainland (t=5040), dave_w (t=5219), mark07 (t=5383), leo_tx (t=5464), and ethan21's 58,437-land mainland (t=5850, after ethan21 also fired 6 intercepts costing 508,900 troops at d=15.4..23.9).

variableEvaluations.currentValue: tryInterceptEnemyBoats: bTr>=80, no fee-to-bTr cap, maxAllowP=35%B (pct<=360), keepFloorP=12*L..28*L, relies on broken bQ.mt.mu(p, boatId) which is always false for human/network chases (causing 74/277 duplicate chases across G00-G09); tryClaimNearTeamIslands: completely non-functional due to s.land vs s.c property mismatch (0 boats fired across all games), leaving V17.boatOut/boatFood to fire 392 uncoordinated boats without team scheduling

variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: 1) Fix s.land -> s.c in tryClaimNearTeamIslands and gate island claims by fee <= 2.5 * sz && wantTr + fee <= 0.06 * B && B - wantTr - fee >= Math.max(65 * L, super.safeAt(g, -1)); 2) In tryInterceptEnemyBoats: require bTr >= Math.max(1500, 1.6 * feeP, 0.25 * dMe * 8) (unless bTr >= 0.65 * (Bp - 15 * Lp) existential threat), cap maxAllowP at 0.10..0.14 * Bp (pct <= 144), raise keepFloorP to Math.max(55 * Lp, 0.75 * super.safeAt(g, -1)), and replace broken bQ.mt.mu with shared window.__tsbTeamChasedBoats Map + bType===6 route-endpoint geometric chaser detection; 3) Gate V17.boatOut / boatFood in team mode when nb.length > 0 or B < 115 * L
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Every boat or chase command in Territorial.io deducts a flat boat tax of iV(32 * B, 1024) = 3.125% of the player's entire balance B (2.67x higher than the 1.17% land attack fee), and troops at sea decay by 1/128 every 5 ticks while earning 0 interest. Across G00-G09, our bots launched 673 boats (277 [HL-INTERCEPT] chases + 396 other boats), burning 4,578,723 troops in boat tax alone and sending >11.8M troops to sea. In tryInterceptEnemyBoats: (a) lack of a fee <= 0.625 * bTr gate caused 83/277 (30.0%) of all intercepts to burn more in 3.125%B boat tax than the entire enemy boat's troop count (and 141/277 = 50.9% had fee > 0.5 * bTr); (b) in live_game_js.js, bB.qg.qy (human chase handler) only calls bQ.iC.abE and NEVER calls bQ.mt.ei, so window.bQ.mt.mu(p, boatId) always returns false for squadmates, causing rank>=1 backup brothers at seenAge>=3 or dBoatToLand<=55 to fire 74 duplicate chases on the same enemy boats; (c) urgentClose allowed sending 35%B down to keepFloor=12*L, stripping coastal pillars (kevin_k, noah88, ethan21) of 38%~50% of their balance per wave. Meanwhile, tryClaimNearTeamIslands read s.land instead of s.c (returned by seaSample at v27-team-live.js:1244), silently failing 100% of the time and leaving unscheduled V17.boatFood/boatOut to drain coastal bots at t=1890..3500.

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: oppFloorCap=38 + collapseFloorCap=16 + totB=B+myOut + prime keep<=10~26*L stripped frontline home density to d=13~26 in G06 (ethan21 d=13..26 on 58k land), making midgame leads impossible to hold.

3.125%B boat tax + 35%B chase cap + broken bQ.mt.mu (20 duplicate chases in G06, 74 overall) + s.land undefined bug in tryClaimNearTeamIslands burned 4.08M troops (1.20M tax + 2.88M sent) in G06 and collapsed coastal pillars kevin_k and noah88.
allyMinSep=112 and clusterMax=350 crammed all 8 bots into a 380x230px eastern pocket in G06, boxing 5 of 8 bots into nb=0 by t=1800 and capping team land at 16.98% (21.04% peak).
pct=51 (5.08%B) donations paid a flat 64/1024 (6.25%B) engine donation tax (55.2% loss rate), burning 6.89M in tax across 108 donations in G06 while draining dave_w at d=40..57.

period=2 (112ms) + 2-tick inflight lock inflated total commands in G06 to 2,836 (354/bot), multiplying 1.17%B land attack tax burn during micro-pulses.
